profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with excellent technical skills as well as communication and interpersonal skills.

Currently enjoying the integration of satellite control subsystems using JEE architecture implemented on Weblogic Server.

Years of experience in building software applications with high quality that meet the needs of the business.  Fast learner who always seeks to stay up-to-date in my skill sets.

positions.title: Software Engineer Staff
positions.description:
•	 Led the conversion to Weblogic Portal V10.3 from V9.2, Weblogic Server V10.0 from V9.2, and Oracle 11G from 10G for the underlying database.  Performed analysis and task planning for potential impacts/changes.
•	Oversaw and contributed to a better GUI so it would be more user-friendly, and to make full use of the newly-designed Weblogic Portal Look and Feel Infrastructure of V10.3.
•	Analyzed, documented, and communicated tasks necessary to convert existing portlet code written by LM and partners and to remove items/code/etc. that was no longer necessary.
•	Presented WPI to prime and subcontractors concerning the new features available and how best to take advantage of them.
•	Created a development kit and written guidance for all partners to use when converting/developing new code for V10.3.  This contained the code framework, sample code, and all supporting items necessary for partners to develop and unit test portal code before delivering to integration.
•	Traveled to prime contractor site as needed to support releases as necessary.  Worked with all partner subcontractors to quickly determine correct sources of issues and responsibility for resolving them.
•	Mentored 3 new members of the team to bring them up to speed and make them more productive more quickly.
•	Served as primary point of contact with the Integration & Testing team throughout the portal conversion testing phase to research, prioritize, and assign issues found.
•	Delivered all assigned coding tasks on time and with quality while following a rigorous release schedule (every 2 weeks).
•	Application technical details:  Oracle Weblogic Server 10.3 running on Windows Server 2003, using Oracle 11G running on Linux via JDBC data sources, LDAP Authentication using Weblogic Server’s Active Directory authenticator for access, Log4J for logging.  LM Portlets created using BEA’s Java Page Flows (Struts-based), also making use of AJAX via Javascript, DOJO 1.1.1 library.

positions.title: Technical Analyst / Project Coordinator / Business Advocate / Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	This role has included helping new teams of developers integrate their software with existing applications and learn the change management and production release processes, as well as helping to coordinate new releases and troubleshoot production issues.
•	Helped coordinate the successful migration of applications during a major conversion of system software.
•	Coordinated technical resources from multiple areas, including internal business resources, outsourced resources, vendors, and external partners.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Web Applications
positions.description:
•	Primary responsibilities included design and development of internal company service-oriented applications written in Java (mid-2006 to mid-2008). One of these applications was written as portlets that were accessed through BEA’s Aqualogic portal and used  JSP/JavaBeans/JavaScript/AJAX.
•	Team member of a major corporate initiative to develop a self-service client portal using BEA Aqualogic as the portal with BEA Weblogic Server as the deployment platform for a SOA-based  application written in Java (mid-2005 to mid-2006).
•	Have been a portal (BEA Aqualogic) administrator since 2003.
•	Principal team member of the initial deployment and rollout of a portal to the entire Dex Media Corporation in 2003-2005. Responsibilities included client needs-based analysis, technical design, development and deployment of custom internal applications utilizing the portal.  Development of web-based applications for this project were done using JSP and ASP against Oracle databases.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Individually supported and refactored a company-wide sales support application (SalesNet) for sales research and sales collateral support.  Application was written in Visual Basic, Perl and SQL deployed on a Windows server platform with a Sybase database.
•	Responsible for analysis and development of many internal company internet-based applications, using Perl scripts and PowerBuilder.  Databases used were Sybase and Microsoft SQL Server.
•	Individually installed and deployed a company-wide web-based password reset system called Courion, running on Windows NT server and using a SQL Server database.
•	Designed and developed enhancements to company-wide Help Desk system (Vantive).  This was a client-server application (UNIX server, Windows and Macintosh clients) with a Sybase database.  Used VB to customize the client based on users’ needs, and developed SQL reports as needed (1997-1998).  Also designed and deployed UNIX shell scripts on the server.

company.name: Qwest Dex / U S WEST Dex

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff – Level 44
positions.description:
•	Principal member of a team that designed and developed computer-based training software (using Macromedia Authorware) that was used annually by 60,000 U S WEST employees from 1996-1999 for required certification.
•	Team member of the Dex billing project to design, develop and deploy a client-server based realtime customer billing system.  Utilized an OMNIS client front end against a Tandem NonStop SQL server system (1993).
•	Designed and developed customizations to a corporate-wide inventory management system used to procure and ship all U S WEST offices their telecommunications parts and supplies from company warehouses.  Used COBOL, VSAM, DB2, SQL (1990-1992).
•	Supported and enhanced a company-wide touchtone ordering system that utilized 3270-emulation software and synthetic voice response and telephony hardware and software.  Application was written in C and deployed on a network of PCs running on QNIX (1989-1992).

positions.title: software developer
positions.description: Software development engineer with various credit and collections applications written in PL/I and COBOL, using CICS.
